title: Lightly Steamed Polish Tofu Dumplings
description: A kid-friendly Polish dish featuring soya milk and steamed dumplings, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This shojin-friendly recipe is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the crumbled tofu, soya milk, flour, salt, black pepper, and nutritional yeast, and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the dumplings in a steamer basket, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly firm to the touch.
Remove the dumplings from the steamer and brush them with olive oil.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Repeat the steaming process until all the dumplings are cooked.
Let the dumplings cool for a few minutes before serving.
